The journal group still balances. The invoice itself is correct as a subsidiary record, so no status change is warranted, and this is not a duplicate, so no void.

One caveat: I'm inferring that the invoice amount is the correct figure, which the finding supports (the subsidiary is the source document, and the header matches the invoice). I'll post to period 12, the latest open period, since the entry corrects an April 2024 item and the open periods are both later than period 4 anyway.
